{{Top|leg}}
A '''microvalve''' was a part of the fluid control system found aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Responding to commands from the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] or copilot, the valve would open or close to allow pressurized fluid to follow a certain path along the flow-track to prompt various systems.
